in_sanskrit.name: नित्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one that is always present, everlasting, unchanging, perennial

in_tamil.name: நித்யம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: one who has come into existence in the world

in_marathi.name: Nitya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nitya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'nitya' meaning perpetual, constant and eternal. It is a name for a baby girl born into the Hindu community.

in_bengali.name: Nitya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Day, Time
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nitya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'nitya' meaning perpetual, constant and eternal. It is a name for a baby girl born into the Hindu community.
